response.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_price) AS mean_price, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number) SELECT AVG(mean_price) AS avg_invoice_mean_price, AVG(line_count) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice FROM inv;

assumptions.assumption: Each row in Invoice_Line_Items is one line item, and only invoices that appear in that table are considered, so invoices with no line items are excluded by the GROUP BY.

AVG ignores NULL product_price values, so an invoice whose line items all have NULL prices gets a NULL mean and drops out of the price average. Such an invoice still counts in the line-item average, since it has at least one line item. A price of 0 is not treated as missing.
